content_sections.heading: ESIC Ludhiana Teaching Faculty and Senior Resident Vacancy 2026 – Department-wise Details
content_sections.text: The notification gives a department-wise, category-wise vacancy breakup across six post levels: Professor, Associate Professor, Assistant Professor, Senior Resident (SR3 – 3-year residency scheme), Senior Resident (SR1 – 1 year against GDMO), and Tutor. "--" indicates no vacancy is currently notified for that post in that department. UR = Unreserved, SC = Scheduled Caste, ST = Scheduled Tribe, OBC = Other Backward Class, EWS = Economically Weaker Section.

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Educational and experience criteria follow the latest NMC (National Medical Commission) norms for all advertised posts. Specific conditions stated in the notification include: For the Tutor post, only candidates holding an MD in the concerned subject are eligible. Candidates with MD/MS in a broad specialty will be considered for the Senior Resident post in a superspeciality department. Candidates with MD/MS in Emergency Medicine, Orthopaedics, Surgery or Anaesthesia - or with 2 years of post-MBBS experience in any of these branches, including 1 year of experience in emergency medicine - are eligible to apply for the Senior Resident post in Emergency. Candidates with MD/MS in Emergency Medicine, Orthopaedics, Surgery or Anaesthesia with relevant experience are eligible to apply for Assistant Professor in Emergency Medicine. If no suitable MD/MS candidate is available, an MBBS candidate with 2 years of experience in the relevant branch will be considered for Senior Resident. Eligibility for qualifying degree/experience is assessed as on the last date of application submission. Age relaxation is applicable as per the prevailing norms of the Government of India.

content_sections.heading: ESIC Ludhiana Terms of Contract
content_sections.text: Tenure is initially for one year, extendable up to three years (renewed yearly based on satisfactory performance), or until the candidate attains 70 years of age, or until a regular incumbent joins - whichever is earliest. The engagement may be terminated by either side with one month's prior notice, without assigning reason. If a candidate resigns without notice, one month's salary must be deposited to the ESI Account through challan. Candidates must deposit a security amount of Rs. 1,00,000/- (by demand draft) at the time of joining, forfeited if they resign within six months. Candidates appointed for a 44-day tenure must deposit Rs. 50,000/- as security, forfeited if they resign during that 44-day period. Faculty are entitled to 2.5 leaves per month. No service benefits such as PF, pension, gratuity, medical allowance, medical benefits, or seniority-based promotion are admissible. Being a contractual appointment, absence from work beyond 7 days without proper permission will be treated as voluntary abandonment and lead to automatic termination. Attendance must be marked manually as well as through the Aadhaar Enabled Bio-metric Attendance System (AEBAS) on scheduled working days. No private practice is allowed in any capacity after joining ESIC Medical College & Hospital, Ludhiana.

content_sections.text: Self-attested copies of the following documents must be attached with the application form, and original documents must be brought to the interview for verification: Certificate of passing Class 10th (for Date of Birth) All mark sheets, attempt details, and degree certificate of MBBS All mark sheets, attempt details, and degree certificate of MD/MS/DNB/other examination Updated Punjab Medical Council/NMC Medical Registration Certificate Proof of publication(s), along with proof of the indexing agency of the journal Experience certificate(s) Relieving/NOC certificate from previous or current employer, if applicable Recent passport-size photograph Aadhaar Card Completion certificate of ICMR/NMC-approved Basic Course in Biomedical Research, if applicable NMC-approved Revised Basic Course in Medical Education Technology Certificate, if applicable Valid EWS/OBC/SC/ST/PwD certificate in the format prescribed for Central Government jobs, wherever applicable

faq.question: Q1. What is ESIC Ludhiana Teaching Faculty and Senior Resident Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment drive by ESIC Medical College & Hospital, Ludhiana, to fill Teaching Faculty posts (Professor, Associate Professor, Assistant Professor, Tutor) and Senior Resident posts on a contract basis, through a walk-in interview.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in ESIC Ludhiana Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The notification does not state one official total figure. Based on the department-wise breakup provided, the computed approximate total is 108 posts, and the notification states these vacancies are provisional and may change.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for ESIC Ludhiana Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must email their filled application form and supporting documents by Friday, 08-08-2026. There is no separate online application deadline, as applications are not submitted through a web portal.

faq.question: Q4. When is the ESIC Ludhiana walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled for 12-08-2026 (Wednesday), with reporting between 09:00 AM and 10:00 AM at the Dean Office, ESIC Medical College Hospital, Ludhiana.

faq.question: Q5. What is the qualification for ESIC Ludhiana Teaching Faculty and Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: Qualification follows the latest NMC norms and varies by post and department — for example, Tutor posts require an MD in the concerned subject, while Senior Resident and Assistant Professor eligibility in certain departments depends on MD/MS qualification or relevant post-MBBS experience, as detailed in the Eligibility section above.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for ESIC Ludhiana Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The age limit, as on the date of interview, is not exceeding 69 years for Teaching Faculty posts and not exceeding 45 years for Senior Resident posts, with age relaxation as per Government of India norms.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application fee for ESIC Ludhiana Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The fee is Rs. 500/- for general category candidates, and Nil for SC/ST/ESIC regular employees/Female candidates/Defence Ex-servicemen/PH candidates, payable via Demand Draft in favour of "ESI Fund A/c No. 1."

faq.question: Q8. How can I apply for ESIC Ludhiana Teaching Faculty and Senior Resident Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is no online application. Candidates must email the filled application form with self-attested documents to [email protected] by 08-08-2026, and then appear in person for the walk-in interview on 12-08-2026.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for ESIC Ludhiana Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection is based on the candidate's academic credentials and performance in an interview conducted by the Selection Board.

faq.question: Q10. What is the salary for ESIC Ludhiana Teaching Faculty and Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: Pay ranges from a fixed basic of Rs. 56,100/- (Tutor, Level 10) to Rs. 1,23,100/- (Professor, Level 13), plus other admissible allowances, with approximate gross salaries between Rs. 1.2 lakh and Rs. 2.5 lakh depending on the post.
